questions.question: Who has scored the most ducks for the South African Women's team in ODI's?
At Bloemfontein Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Gezelle Jansen van Rensburg holds it with 19.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Cobras or Dolphins?
At which ground did Cobras record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Wanderers — highest total of 198, against Lions on 2024/11/17.

questions.question: How many wicketkeeping dismissals separate the all-time #1 (Yolandi van der Westhuizen) and #2 (Trisha Chetty) wicketkeepers (List A)?
questions.explanation: Yolandi van der Westhuizen: 104 — Trisha Chetty: 94 — a gap of 10.

questions.question: At which ground did Cynthia Naidoo record their career-best bowling figures (5-24, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval, against Tuskers on 2024/11/16.
